receiptScope: Historical pre-final antiwindup PI; actual 900s active trajectory completes but rejects complete frost-cycle release

warnings: Generic component parameters and control assumptions; not manufacturer calibrated.
Outdoor metal and retained water/ice share one equilibrium temperature.
Ice sublimation is excluded; retained ice melts or receives deposition.

Dirt scales air flow and air-side conductance at fixed fan command. Generic inverter indoor fans command 25–100% airflow across the thermostat band, linear air-side conductance and cubic electric power; no measured fan map.

Conserved R32 charge uses finite-volume refrigerant cells per coil, shared outdoor/indoor pressures and a finite accumulator restriction; internal geometry and EEV/compressor maps are generic assumptions.
Field lines store actual refrigerant volume but are hydraulically idealized and adiabatic; friction, ambient line heat, elevation, slip and oil are excluded in this formulation.
Superheat is controlled by finite EEV movement; subcooling and exchanged heat emerge from the stored charge, rather than fixed charge multipliers.

Generic inventory inverter displacement ramps from rest at 2 rps/s and reduces at 4 rps/s; rotor inertia and motor losses are excluded. Fixed-speed and dedicated defrost retain their separate startup policy. Pressure/temperature supervision and restart dwell override demand. Stopped discharge predictions are control estimates, not sensor states.
